annotation.bound_parties_text: The plan sets out measures the Government (ministries and agencies) will implement and imposes no binding obligations on private parties.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This Chapter sets forth the “measures that the Government should comprehensively and systematically implement to promote research and development, and utilization of AI-related technology,”
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Japan will formulate the “Second AI Basic Plan” pursuant to Article 18, paragraph (1) of the AI Act
